name: Business Launch Checklist
description: A launch-week checklist of everything to do when opening a new business.

items.text: Confirm your launch date and create a day-by-day timeline.
Assign clear owners to each launch task.
Run a soft launch or dry run with a small audience.
Test your website, checkout and booking flow end to end.
Prepare answers to likely customer questions.
Brief your team on roles, hours and responsibilities.
Write a clear launch announcement and key message.
Prepare graphics, photos and video for your channels.
Draft an email to your existing list and contacts.
Schedule social media posts across launch week.
Reach out to local media, partners or relevant communities.
Ask friends, family and supporters to share the news.
Publish your launch on every channel you use.
Update your website homepage to feature the launch.
Confirm your business listings and maps profile are live.
Set up any paid ads with budget and targeting.
Add launch banners or pop-ups where customers will see them.
Track which channels are driving the most interest.
Decide on a clear opening offer or promotion.
Set start and end dates so the offer feels urgent.
Confirm the offer is profitable and easy to fulfill.
Create a referral incentive for early customers.
Prepare any coupon codes or promo links.
Train staff to apply and explain the offer correctly.
Confirm inventory, stock or capacity for the rush.
Test that payments process correctly.
Make sure fulfillment or delivery is ready to scale.
Set up customer support channels and response times.
Check that staffing matches expected demand.
Have a backup plan for technical or supply issues.
Go live and confirm everything is working.
Monitor sales, traffic and sign-ups in real time.
Respond quickly to customer questions and issues.
Capture feedback and testimonials from early customers.
Fix any problems that surface on the day.
Thank customers and your team for the support.
Review results and plan your follow-up marketing.

faq.q: When should I start preparing for launch week?
faq.a: Begin two to four weeks ahead so you can build anticipation, line up your channels and pressure-test operations. Use this checklist to sequence the final days and avoid last-minute surprises.

faq.q: Should I do a soft launch first?
faq.a: A soft launch to a small audience is a smart way to catch problems before the public opening. It lets you fix issues quietly, then go bigger with confidence during your main launch.

faq.q: What makes a launch offer effective?
faq.a: A clear, time-limited incentive that's easy to understand and act on — such as a discount, bundle or bonus for early customers. Make sure it's profitable and easy for your team to honor.

faq.q: What should I measure on launch day?
faq.a: Track sales, traffic, sign-ups and customer feedback, plus any operational hiccups. These early numbers tell you what's working and where to adjust quickly.

faq.q: Is this available as a printable PDF?
faq.a: Yes. Print the launch checklist or download the PDF to coordinate your team and check off tasks throughout launch week.
